entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this jersey I bought. It's completely unacceptable and I want my money back now. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF-8675309. I got the Aero Race Jersey and it's the wrong size. It's so tight I can barely get it on. This is the last time I buy from you people.
Okay, I've pulled up your order. I see you purchased the Aero Race Jersey and it was delivered about 27 days ago. Is that correct?

Don't play games with me, it doesn't matter if it was 27 days or 27 minutes ago. Your policy says 90 days. I want to exchange this or get a refund. If you give me any hassle, I swear I'll be speaking to your manager and leaving a review on every single website I can find.

There will be no hassle at all, sir. You're absolutely correct. Our policy for items like this jersey is a 90-day return window. Since it's only been 27 days, you are well within that period. We can definitely process this for you.
Oh. So you're just going to do it then? No problem?
No problem whatsoever. I can set up a return for a full refund, or if you'd prefer, I can process an exchange for a larger size. Whichever works best for you.
Fine. Just give me the refund. The whole experience has been a mess.

I understand completely. I've just initiated the return for a full refund. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to your package, and you can drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be issued once we receive the item.
Alright. Good. That's what I expected.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Okay. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
